area: Authoritative analytics history and exact financial basis
sourceFixes: Reject realized documents whose currency differs from the specific frozen opportunity, even if both currencies exist elsewhere in the forecast.
Parse and reject malformed/reversed history cutoffs before invoking the RPC; use those parsed instants when checking the response.
preservedFailures: Sandboxed format produced formatted files but exited 1 on the inaccessible telemetry cache; authorized rerun exited 0.
Sandboxed Flutter test could not open SDK lockfile; preserved platform-focused-test.log.

First authorized focused test had five passes and one incorrect matcher expectation; preserved platform-focused-test-unsandboxed.log; strict UTC parser throws DomainError VALIDATION_ERROR and final test matches it.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-505: Every metric result MUST identify definition version, unit, scope, filters, business cutoff, recorded cutoff, source versions, generation time, population counts, completeness, and drill-through basis.
openRows.recommendation: Retain full canonical manifest and basis for every process, history, ratio, cash and export result; statement summaries alone do not reproduce canonical statement hashes.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-506: Process analytics MUST use immutable recorded transitions and an explicit cohort; events recorded after the captured cutoff MUST not alter that result, and current document status MUST not substitute for history.
openRows.recommendation: Run late source commit/backfill after a captured complete server snapshot and reproduce retained cutoff and transition manifests under current authorization.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-509: Pipeline conversion, aging, coverage, velocity, and owner metrics MUST publish their cohorts and history basis; unavailable historical amount, probability, ownership, or stage evidence MUST block the affected metric.
openRows.recommendation: Run complete historical stage/amount/probability/owner source cases and the missing-history/gap rejection against installed providers.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-510: Pipeline forecasts MUST freeze opportunity revisions, explicit probability/close-date assumptions, currency, and any approved FX-rate version; different currencies MUST not be silently summed.
openRows.recommendation: Retain genuine frozen opportunity revisions and assumptions with separate currencies; test source changes, missing FX and freeze/reopen.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-511: Forecast accuracy MUST compare a frozen forecast with a defined realized-result cohort and horizon; zero denominators and missing mappings MUST produce a named unavailable state rather than infinity or fabricated zero.
openRows.recommendation: Capture a nonempty realized cohort after its horizon and verify exact invoice/credit mapping, zero denominator and incomplete mapping states through genuine actors.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-512: Financial ratios MUST reference exact authoritative statement snapshots, governed account classifications, and versioned formulas using the same scope, period, currency, and publication basis.
openRows.recommendation: Retain full immutable statements and governed account classifications, reproduce classified operands and formulas, and verify matching scope/period/currency.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-513: Cash forecasts MUST consume verified bank/cash controls and dated remaining obligations, excluding duplicate allocations and explicitly separating receivables, payables, payroll, and unsupported obligation kinds.
openRows.recommendation: Retain dated bank/cash controls and each AR/AP/payroll/project residual with settlements, reversals and duplicate-allocation rejection.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-514: Forecast scenarios MUST preserve immutable versions of assumptions and overrides; a projected balance MUST never post or amend a journal, obligation, stock movement, or source document.
openRows.recommendation: Execute actual scenario revision/freeze/reopen and compare before/after journal, stock, obligation and source fingerprints; actual scenarios remain unproved.

openRows.fullStatement: NFR-502: Monetary values, ratios, probabilities, usage amounts, and durations MUST use decimal strings and exact integer/decimal arithmetic; zero binary floating-point financial calculations are permitted.
openRows.recommendation: Complete exact decimal cross-provider and export reproduction, including usage/probabilities and negative/zero states; this audit covers nine retained ratio rows only.

openRows.fullStatement: NFR-510: Identical validated source snapshots and definition versions MUST reproduce identical metric values irrespective of input ordering; historical replay MUST preserve recorded cutoff and current authorization checks.
openRows.recommendation: Replay each installed provider with reordered complete snapshots and current permission checks; retain stable exact values and recorded cutoff.

openRows.fullStatement: AC-504: Pipeline evidence and accuracy (FR-509, FR-510, FR-511, NFR-502) Given frozen opportunities, currencies, assumptions, forecasts, and realized cohorts When conversion, forecast, and accuracy are requested Then totals follow the published basis and missing history or zero denominators are explicit.
openRows.recommendation: Complete authoritative frozen forecast/history/realized cohorts and all missing-history, mixed-currency and zero-denominator cases.

openRows.fullStatement: AC-505: Financial ratios (FR-512, NFR-502) Given authoritative statement snapshots with matching scope and formula revisions When a ratio is calculated Then its exact numerator, denominator, value, and source evidence are reproducible.
openRows.recommendation: Reproduce classified numerator/denominator from account-level authoritative publications, not just precomputed operands or summaries.

openRows.fullStatement: EC-504: Empty samples, mixed currencies, negative/zero denominator, missing FX or historical opportunity revision do not fabricate ratios; verify with AC-504/505.
openRows.recommendation: Exercise installed empty/negative/zero/mixed-currency/missing-FX/missing-history paths; the client now rejects per-opportunity currency substitution.

openRows.fullStatement: EC-505: A settlement, reversal, credit, payroll liability or absent AP provider would double-count or omit an obligation; fail the affected forecast basis; verify with AC-506.
openRows.recommendation: Execute settled/reversed/credited/payroll/AP residual coverage against installed providers; reject any incomplete or duplicated obligation basis.

openRows.fullStatement: FR-552: The input MUST be a complete bounded authorized snapshot of events; source contract revision, scope, document kind, row count, immutable source manifest and cutoffs MUST travel with it. A partially fetched page MUST not be accepted as a complete calculation input.
openRows.recommendation: Retain a complete bounded authorized event snapshot manifest and reject truncation at the installed provider boundary, with source revision/count/cutoffs bound.

Authorization remains the installed provider responsibility; no client hash or this offline audit grants access.
